name: Verify 362 fused UTF-8 benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/profile-fused-utf8-candidate.lisp'
      - '.github/workflows/verify-362-fused-benchmark.yml'

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          shared-key: verify-362-fused-utf8
      - name: Build my-lisp CLI
        run: cargo build -p my-lisp-cli --bin my-lisp
      - name: Measure fused UTF-8 candidate
        run: |
          /usr/bin/time -f 'fused_profile_wall_seconds=%e' \
            ./target/debug/my-lisp scripts/profile-fused-utf8-candidate.lisp
